title: Kiwi community catalog entry
description: Discovery metadata only. A valid entry is not a security review, compatibility test, or installation authorization.

slug.description: Stable directory identity; must match the YAML filename without its extension.

license.description: The app's license; use an SPDX identifier or expression where available. This validator does not verify licensing claims.

compatibility.description: Author-declared supported Kiwi/SDK versions or a concise compatibility statement. Not a tested badge.

manifestPath.description: Optional path to the author's own app metadata, relative to their repository root. No installation semantics are implied.

httpsUrl.$comment: The CLI implements https-url with Node's URL parser to require a valid HTTPS host/port and no user information. Other schema consumers must register this custom format too.
httpsUrl.description: A public HTTPS URL without embedded credentials. Reachability and ownership require human review.
